en: Uh it all started when um I I'm still doing that, but I used to be a lot more invested into algorithmic trading, and um, I've done this uh for a living for a while, and actually with great results, I was very happy about that.

speaker: Ran Arusi

en: Uh they were just trying to land them as a client or something.

en: Uh but yeah, this is definitely not the only library that does this.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Uh I I just think that it it's doing it really well and that the interface is um API-wise, is very uh Pythonic and very simple, which is something that I really uh believe in.

en: Uh let's cut the number of uh code lines that you need to have.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Uh I act as uh kind of uh the uh the the the spirit of the company.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: I help uh with the specing of the products because my experience uh uh over the past few decades is uh I have been both in product and in tech.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So I'm kind of walk and untalk the the two uh languages.

en: And uh I have a great team that's scattered all around Europe that does the actual development.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: And uh one of uh my most recent pet projects that turned into a behemoth of code base, although it's not nearly as used as what as Wi-Finance is as MUX is you mentioned, which is um a different take on how I think AI should be deployed, which is having agents as primitive give them their own um application server, and um make sure that you don't have to code your way into having an agentic platform, but just deploy.

en: So it's kind of like a Docker uh in terms of how you deploy, it's like um Maxi pull, push, you pull a formation which is in the entire setup.

speaker: Simon Maple
en: So yeah, a formation a formation is a unit of is like a collection of agents, is that correct?

speaker: Simon Maple
en: Yes, right.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Yeah, so at the top of the a formation is is it's not just a collection of agents, but it also includes what I call the overlord, kind of the orchestrator that decides of the formation's personality, and uh the agents themselves are sort of minions because I didn't want the experience of having to remember which agent I need to talk to.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: This one does email, this one's a good writer, and I I just wanted to talk to Jarvis and have uh and have it manage whatever agents it it needs.
zh: 这个管邮件,这个擅长写作,我只想和 Jarvis 说话,然后让它去管理它需要的任何智能体。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So um uh affirmation uh basically tells me okay, which models am I going to use, what are the the backup whether or not I have role-based uh access management, what type of uh memory allowance do I give the database?
zh: 所以,呃,呃,一个 affirmation 基本上告诉我,好吧,我要用哪些模型,备用方案是什么,我有没有基于角色的访问管理,我给数据库多大的内存配额?

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Um is this an organizational deployment where I'm gonna use Postgres with uh all uh different types of extension, or just for me and I'm just gonna use uh MySQL?

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: And it's all configuration files.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Um so there's no code involved.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Uh it's again fully open source, uh available in agentformations.org.
zh: 呃,它同样完全开源,在 agentformations.org 上可以获取。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: And um yeah, it allows you to define both the obviously the soul of the document, what it can do, the tools, uh the domain knowledge for every agent, uh, access to uh it has a very elaborate memory um uh structure where it has uh it differentiates between uh preferences, memories, decisions, claims, working memory, buffer memory, uh episodic memory, recent memory.
zh: 然后,呃,是的,它允许你定义——显然首先是文档的灵魂,它能做什么、工具,呃,每个智能体的领域知识,呃,访问——它有一个非常精细的内存,呃,呃,结构,它会区分,呃,偏好、记忆、决策、主张、工作记忆、缓冲记忆,呃、情景记忆、近期记忆。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So it's a very layered type of memory because what I'm trying to do is mimic how the uh I'm re I'm really uh uh philosophic philosophical here because what I'm trying to do is mimic how the human brain works when it comes to memories.
zh: 所以它是一种非常分层的记忆类型,因为我想做的是模仿,呃,我在这点上真的有点哲学化了,因为我想做的是模仿人脑在记忆方面的工作方式。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Uh there's the misconception where uh observation and logging is memory.
zh: 呃,有一个误解,就是观察和日志就是记忆。

en: I don't think so.
zh: 我不这么认为。

en: I think the distillation of um of knowledge and uh recall is the memory because we might not remember every single word that we that was said here, but we're gonna have the takeaways, we're gonna remember conclusions and things that we've agreed on.
zh: 我认为知识的蒸馏和,呃,回忆才是记忆,因为我们可能记不住在这里说过的每一个字,但我们会记住要点,我们会记住结论以及我们达成一致的东西。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: And I think that's how an agentic memory needs to work.
zh: 而我认为智能体记忆就应该这样工作。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So it's all bundled in, you don't have to worry about it, you don't have to um, you just need to essentially configure what your uh agentic AI can do.

en: You know, you're using uh Stripe MCP with uh million tools over there, and you only need three, so there's no reason to hog the memory.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Just tell okay, these are the only two or three tools that I actually use in this application.

en: It's not gonna load any of the other ones into memory.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Uh so yeah, it's uh it's it's very well thought out based on the needs that I've encountered both in my own own personal kind of Jarvis uh journey and what I noticed with uh with organizations that uh we've deployed we actually created a separate company in the US for deployment uh deploying agentic um um AI at the organizational level.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So yeah, that's in a gist.
zh: 所以是的,大致就是这样。

en: And what one of the interesting things there is the the kind of like operating instructions, as it were, for for for a uh for a formation.

en: Um I believe that that can that the the they can kind of like retrospectively look at those instructions and say actually I want to change I want to change my own instructions based on historic kind of like how things have been done.

en: Uh I actually think uh that it's more of a trust line.

en: I think that technically you can create a fully autonomous uh system, and I I was actually talking about this yesterday.

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: So the first uh line of defense is make sure that it has up-to-date information, it that it knows how to not only store it but retrieve the right uh information, which is not on always just contextual, it it needs to have the the graph of relationships there.

speaker: Ran Arusi

en: So you're giving it a goal, and if you're not going to intervene at any point and say, okay, after five tries, after two hours, whatever it is that you set as a threshold, come back to me and say, I can't do it, and let me let me help you uh get unstuck.

en: If you don't do that, agents will either um create slop or run uh very high token bill because it's just gonna keep trying, or they're gonna fake the tests uh just to to to have the test passed.

speaker: Ran Arusi

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: Everything else you can put on different constraints on the system where you don't really have to look at the code anymore, because if you put enough constraints that says, okay, the we need to achieve this level of uh uh code profiling, and this need we need to achieve uh the these amount of tests and regression tests.
zh: 其他一切你都可以给系统设置不同的约束，让你不必再看代码了，因为如果你设置足够多的约束，说，好吧，我们需要达到这个级别的代码性能分析，我们需要达到这个数量的测试和回归测试。

speaker: Ran Arusi
en: And you put all sorts of constraints that by definition the code quality is good if everything is green.

speaker: Ran Arusi
